mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post(user_id, content, images, videos, cover, like_count, comment_count) VALUES(#{userId}, #{content}, #{images, typeHandler=com.example.item.demo35.util.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{videos, typeHandler=com.example.item.demo35.util.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{cover}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.name AS user_name, u.number AS user_number, u.email AS user_email, u.age AS user_age, u.sex AS user_sex, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.*, u.name AS user_name, u.number AS user_number, u.email AS user_email, u.age AS user_age, u.sex AS user_sex, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.*, u.name AS user_name, u.number AS user_number, u.email AS user_email, u.age AS user_age, u.sex AS user_sex, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT SUM(like_count) FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND like_count > 0
UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND comment_count > 0
